outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its upper handle, then pulls the door outward: separation from the oven body is visible by frames 83–92 in image. The door remains visibly ajar at frames 120–135 in image and left_ego_image, establishing opening, although not a fully lowered door. No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
